name: items_per_combo
source_sql: SELECT combo_id AS "comboId", COUNT(*) AS n FROM product_combo_item GROUP BY combo_id ORDER BY combo_id

name: combo_catalog_in_default_order
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", name->>'en_US' AS name, sequence, company_id AS "companyId" FROM product_combo ORDER BY sequence, id

name: items_with_extra_price
source_sql: SELECT id AS "_id", combo_id AS "comboId", product_id AS "productId", extra_price AS "extraPrice", company_id AS "companyId" FROM product_combo_item WHERE extra_price > 0 ORDER BY id
